items.condition: Unbalanced exchanges, incompatible elemental/magnetic references, uncorrected nonstoichiometric energy ranking, a fabricated source CIF, or static energies presented as measured kinetics invalidate affected claims. Attributing source NEXAFS supercell, k-mesh or GW-PAW settings to an undisclosed NEB protocol is a provenance error.

Fabricated or absent artifacts, unrelated raw runs, unresolvable object/record/quantity links, mismatched hashes or failed computations presented as completed evidence. A declared bounded failure is reportable but is not a complete answer.

Copied author numbers or a legacy scalar without evidence supporting the current question; prose-only mechanisms; missing necessary evidence hidden behind an unresolved label. Do not fail a valid alternative route merely for omitting a reference operation.

A vacancy formation energy alone does not prove a diffusion rate, and favorable static energetics does not demonstrate800 °C precipitation kinetics. Nonstoichiometric slab totals cannot be compared without composition accounting; a two-face slab energy does not automatically resolve each termination separately. Bulk phase stability does not itself model an interface or nucleation barrier.
